name: Palo Brunch Belgian Waffles & Buttermilk Pancakes
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Crisp-tender Belgian waffles and fluffy buttermilk pancakes made from refined white flour are completely seedless and citrus-free.

watchOuts: Berry compote seeds if not ordered plain
